name: Additive neurotoxicity risk
actions: Review the combined neurologic adverse-effect burden.
Monitor for new or worsening confusion, tremor, ataxia, cognitive changes, or other neurologic symptoms.
Consider patient-specific factors that may increase exposure or neurologic vulnerability.

rationale: Both drugs can contribute to neurologic toxicity or adverse-effect burden.
Combined exposure may increase clinically relevant neurologic effects.

explanation_template: {A_name} and {B_name} both contribute neurotoxicity risk. Combined exposure may increase neurologic adverse-effect burden (educational).

references.citation: PD stacking: overlapping neurotoxicity risk may increase neurologic adverse effects.
